class.name: TimerInstance
class.brief_description: A timer created in code, without a scene.

method.name: add_time
method.description: Adds [param time_sec] to the shown time (time left for a countdown, elapsed time for a stopwatch). Use a negative value to remove time.

method.name: get_elapsed_time
method.description: Returns the time that has passed since the timer was started, in seconds.

method.name: get_rid
method.description: Returns the [RID] of the timer in [TimerServer].

method.name: get_time_left
method.description: Returns the time until the timer ends, in seconds. A countdown that has not been started yet returns its full time ([member TimerInfo.total_time]). This is [code]0.0[/code] after [method stop] or the end, and for a stopwatch that is not running or has no [member TimerInfo.total_time].

method.name: get_time_text
method.description: Returns [member current_time] formatted with [method TimerServer.format_time]. A countdown is rounded up to the smallest unit in [param format].

method.name: is_running
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the timer was started and has not ended or been stopped. A paused timer is still running.

method.name: is_stopped
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the timer is stopped or has not started.

method.name: restart
method.description: Resumes the timer if it is paused and starts it from the beginning.

method.name: resume
method.description: Resumes the timer if it is paused. Emits [signal pause_changed].

method.name: start
method.description: Starts the timer from the beginning, or resets it if it was started already. Emits [signal started]. This does not resume a paused timer; see [method resume]. While running, the instance is kept alive by [TimerServer]; one that never ends (looping, or a stopwatch without [member TimerInfo.total_time]) must be stopped to be freed.

method.name: stop
method.description: Stops the timer. Emits [signal stopped], but not [signal timeout].

members.member: The shown time: the time left for a countdown (its full time before the first [method start], [code]0[/code] after [method stop] or the end), the elapsed time for a stopwatch.
If [code]true[/code], the timer is paused. A paused timer does not advance until this is set back to [code]false[/code].
The [TimerInfo] that describes this timer. Changes to the resource apply live.

signal.name: alert_reached
signal.description: Emitted when a time from [member TimerInfo.alerts] is reached. [param time] is the alert in shown time.

signal.name: pause_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the timer is paused or resumed.

signal.name: started
signal.description: Emitted when the timer is started.

signal.name: stopped
signal.description: Emitted when the timer is stopped.

signal.name: ticked
signal.description: Emitted every [member TimerInfo.tick_interval]. [param time] is the shown time.

signal.name: timeout
signal.description: Emitted when the timer reaches its end.
